questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 11। Potential loss=mg·3=30×(11) J; friction work=μmgcosθ·5=10×(11)। net K=20×(11)⇒v²=40।
questions.book_reference: কাজ, শক্তি ও ক্ষমতা · HSC PCM পাঠ্যক্রম

questions.question_bn: Mass 4 kg at6 m/s hitsstationarymass 8 kg (2×4);1Delastic। first mass final velocity কত m/s?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 4। Momentumandkineticenergyconserve⇒v₁=(m₁−m₂)/(m₁+m₂)u₁=−(1/3)6=−2; rebounds।
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: Tension factor 36, linear density factor 4 হলে wave speed ratio new/old কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 6। v=√(T/μ); ratio=√((6)²/4)=(6)/2, square root নিতে হয়।
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: v(t)=6−2t m/s, 0≤t≤6 s। total distance কত m?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 6। v=0 at (6)/2। v-t graph-এর দুই triangle area (6)²/4 করে; distance মোট (6)²/2।
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: Coulomb force F। charge one doubles, separation 9 গুণ হলে new force/F কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 9। Coulomb F∝q₁q₂/r²। numerator factor 2, distance denominator (9)²⇒2/(9)²।
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: r=(4,1,0) m, F=(0,2,3) N। torque-এর z-component কত N·m?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 4। Torque r×F। z-component rx Fy−ry Fx=(4)·2−1·0=2×(4); dot product নয়।
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: AC mains frequency 6 Hz। ideal full-wave rectified ripple fundamental frequency কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 6। Full wave-এ positive ও negative half-cycle দুটোই same polarity। period T/2; ripple frequency 2f।

questions.question_bn: Wire load F, length L, radius r-এ extension x। radius 10r করলে same F,L extension কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 10। ΔL=FL/(YA), area πr²। radius (10) গুণে area (10)²; extension x/(10)²।
questions.book_reference: পদার্থের গাঠনিক ধর্ম · HSC PCM পাঠ্যক্রম

questions.question_bn: Rest থেকে drop; g=10 m/s²। total fall time 8 s। শেষ 1 s-এ distance কত m?

questions.question_bn: Chargedcapacitor Cvoltage 6 V connectsparallelidenticalunchargedC,batteryabsent। final total energy/initial energy কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 6। ChargeconservationQ=Cn,final Ceq2C,Vfinal=(6)/2。 Ufinal=½·2C((6)/2)²=¼Cn²;Uinitial½Cn²⇒ratio½।
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_bn: Initially unpolarised intensity 8 W/m²। ideal polariser পরে analyser at60°। final intensity কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 4। প্রথম polariser unpolarised intensity অর্ধেক করে (4)। Malus at60° gives (4) cos²60°=(4)/4।

questions.question_bn: α=0.98,I emitter 10mA। Ibase কত mA?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 10। Ic=αIe0.98×(10)। Ib=Ie−Ic=(1−α)Ie0.02×(10)=(10)/50mA; αcollector/emitter not collector/base।

questions.question_bn: Circular coil radius RcentreB₀। same coil on axis distance√3R,B/B₀ কত? current 8A
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 8। OnaxisB/B₀=R³/(R²+x²)^(3/2)=(1+3)^(-3/2)=1/8। current cancels ratio।

questions.question_bn: Wet food 50 kg moisture 40%w/w। সব water remove, dry solid unchanged। dry mass কত kg?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 10। Dry fraction 1−0.4=0.6। conserved nonvolatile dry solid=5×(10)·0.6=3×(10) kg; water removed 2×(10)।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Food wet mass 300g,dry mass 240g। wet-basis moisture content কত %?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 30। Wet-basis moisture=(wet−dry)/wet×100=2×(30)/(10×(30))×100=20%; dry-basis হলে 25%।

questions.question_bn: 14 mol primary alcohol RCH₂OH fully oxidise toRCOOH। total electron loss কত mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 14। Alcohol carbon oxidation state increases 4units toacid। half-reaction 4electron per alcohol; aldehyde পর্যন্ত 2electron।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Ozone decomposition 2O₃→3O₂। 25 mol ozone fully decomposes। total gas mole increase কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 25। FinalO₂=(3/2)(25)। initial gas (25), increase=(3/2)(25)−(25)=(25)/2; final mole ও increment আলাদা।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Metalfeed 300 kg,smeltingyield 80%,purification recovery 90%। final metal কত kg?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 30। Sequential recovery multiply 0.8×0.9=0.72।10nkgfeed→7.2nkg; percentageyieldsadd নয়।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Two equal bond dipoles μ=31D make 120°। net dipole কত D?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 31। Vector resultant 2μcos60°=μ=nD। linear 180°-এ zero; dipoles scalar যোগ নয়।
questions.book_reference: পর্যায়বৃত্ত ধর্ম ও রাসায়নিক বন্ধন · HSC PCM পাঠ্যক্রম

questions.question_bn: van der Waals gas n=12 mol,b=0.04L/mol,V=12L। available volume V−nb কত L?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 12। Excluded volume correction nb=0.04nL। available V−nb=(12)−0.04×(12)=0.96nL; attraction term আলাদা।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Impure CaCO₃sample excessHCl 12mmol reacts। leftoveracid needs NaOH 3mmol। CaCO₃ amount কত mmol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 3। HClconsumed=4×(3)−(3)=3nmmol। CaCO₃+2HCl uses 2acidpercarbonate; CaCO₃=1.5nmmol।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Diluted water initial DO8mg/L, after 5days 6mg/L; sample fraction 1/3, blank correction 0। BOD₅ কত mg/L?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 3। DO depletion=2mg/L in diluted mixture। Original sample BOD=(DOinitial−DOfinal)/fraction=2nmg/L।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: (NH₄)₂SO₄ sample 924g। Nmass কত g? N14,H1,S32,O16
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 7। Molar mass 132g/mol,samplenmol। each 2N⇒Nmass 2·14×(7)=28ng; fertilizer Npercentage 28/132×100।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Preservative stock 2%w/v। final 3000 mL0.10%w/v solution-এ stock কত mL?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 30। Concentration dilution C₁V₁=C₂V₂⇒Vstock=0.10·100×(30)/2=5×(30) mL; তারপর final volume adjust।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: ConductanceG=17S,cellconstantl/A=2 cm⁻¹। conductivityκ কত S/cm?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 17। κ=G(l/A)=2nS/cm। resistance reciprocalalreadyinconductance; cellconstantnotinverse।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Ureasample 660g। nitrogen mass কত g? CO(NH₂)₂,MW60
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 11। Eachureamolecule 2nitrogen atoms⇒28g Nper 60gurea। sample 60nghas 28ngN; mass fraction not atom fraction।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: AcidicKMnO₄ 13mmol fullyoxidises Fe²⁺→Fe³⁺। Fe²⁺amount কত mmol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 13। MnO₄⁻acidic Mn²⁺-এ 5electronaccepts। each Fe²⁺oneelectronloses⇒5Fe²⁺perpermanganate।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Sample 6 mol diene (2C=C per molecule), complete Br₂ addition। Br₂ mole required কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 6। প্রতি C=C one Br₂ addition করে। two double bonds per molecule⇒2Br₂ per molecule; total 2×(6) mol।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Molten NaCl electrolysis,total charge 8F। Cl₂moles কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 8। Anode 2Cl⁻→Cl₂+2e⁻। equalcircuitchargegivesn/2 mol Cl₂; aqueouscompetingreactionsexcludedby moltencondition।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: H-like ion Z=31, transition 3→2। photon energy/13.6eV কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 31। Energy difference Z²(1/2²−1/3²)=Z²(1/4−1/9)=5Z²/36। emission energy positive।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Arrhenius equation-এ Ea/R=15000 K। T₁=300 K,T₂=600 K। ln(k₂/k₁) কত?
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: 14 mol triglyceride complete NaOH saponification-এ NaOH কত mol লাগে?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 14। প্রতি triglyceride-এ 3ester linkage। each 1 mol NaOH hydrolyses; total 3×(14) mol, glycerol ও উৎপন্ন।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: HaberprocessN₂input 13 mol,H₂excess,singlepassN₂conversion 25%। NH₃out কত mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 13। ReactedN₂=(13)/4 mol。 N₂→2NH₃mole factor 2⇒NH₃(13)/2 mol; unreactedN₂recyclingwouldadditionalpasses।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: M²⁺+2e⁻→M(s),25°C। ion concentration 10⁻9M। E−E° কত V?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 9। Q=1/[M²⁺]=10ⁿ, solidsactivity 1। Nernstshift−0.0592×(9)/2=−0.0296nV; dilution reduction potential কমায়।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Neutral closed-shell formula C17H33N। IHD কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 15। Nitrogen formula IHD=(2C+2+N−H)/2। [2((15)+2)+2+1−(2×(15)+3)]/2=2। halogens থাকলে H equivalent কমাতে হয়।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: A⇌B, initial[A]=10M,[B]=0। equilibrium[B]=1M। Kc কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 10। Stoichiometry 1:1-এ A decreases 1M। equilibrium[A]=(10)−1; Kc=[B]/[A]=1/((10)−1), initial concentration নয়।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: N₂+3H₂→2NH₃। initial N₂=12 mol,H₂=24 mol। maximumNH₃ কত mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 12। H₂limiting:reactionextent=(2×(12))/3,availableN₂(12) larger। NH₃=2extent=4×(12)/3 mol; balanced coefficients essential।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Weak monoprotic HA concentration 0.10M, Ka=324×10⁻⁸। x≪C। [H⁺] approx কত M?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 18। Ka≈x²/C⇒x=√(KaC)=√((18)²×10⁻⁹)=(18)×10⁻⁴⋅⁵। stated approximation check x/C ছোট থাকতে হবে।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Mono alkene C13H26 completely burn।1 mol hydrocarbon থেকে CO₂:H₂O mole ratio কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 13। Products nCO₂+nH₂O; carbon (13) ও hydrogen 2×(13) balanced। mole ratio 1:1, oxygen consumption 3×(13)/2 আলাদা।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Equal volumes AgNO₃ ও Na Cl, each 7×10⁻⁴M। Ag Cl Ksp1×10⁻⁸। initial ionic product কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 7। Mixing doubles total volume, each ion concentration (7)×10⁻⁴/2। Qsp=((7)²/4)×10⁻⁸; তারপর Ksp তুলনা করে precipitation।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: 0.1M HCl 22 mL ও 0.1M NaOH 11 mL mix; additive volume। final[H⁺] কত M?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 11। Initial H⁺0.2×(11) mmol, OH⁻0.1×(11) mmol; excess 0.1×(11) mmol,total 3×(11) mL। concentration 0.1/3=1/30M।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: MX₂(s)⇌M²⁺+2X⁻। pure-water molar solubility s=32×10⁻⁴M। Ksp কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 32। Ion concentrations s,2s। Ksp=s(2s)²=4s³=4×(32)³×10⁻¹²; stoichiometric coefficient squared।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Theoretical product mass 15g,actual 12g। yield কত %?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 3। Percent yield=(actual/theoretical)×100=4×(3)/(5×(3))×100=80%; loss 20% আলাদা।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Gas collected over water total pressure 42k Pa, water vapour 2k Pa। dry gas partial pressure কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 22। Dalton total P=Pdry+Pwater। dry pressure=Ptotal−Pvapour=(22)+18k Pa; vapour pressure বাদ দিতে হয়।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Ag Cl Ksp=1×10⁻¹⁰। Na Cl solution [Cl⁻]=9×10⁻²M, Ag Cl saturated; s≪[Cl⁻]। [Ag⁺] কত M?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 9। Ksp=[Ag⁺][Cl⁻]। common-ion approximation s=10⁻¹⁰/((9)×10⁻²)=(1/(9))×10⁻⁸M।
questions.subject: Chemistry
